## Agent Workflow 0.12.0

This compatibility release updates Agent Judge to 0.15.0, Agent Client to 0.29.0, and Agent
Journal to 1.8.0.

Gate evaluation now distinguishes a returned decision from an inconclusive verdict and preserves
the complete verdict trail through recovery paths. Loop results represent absent measurements
explicitly instead of treating them as zero, and gate tests pin the updated Judge semantics.
